modelingReview: Side/back mini-views simplify or omit weapons. Define a single gear assembly and handedness contract before modeling/rigging; do not treat generated views as exact orthographic drawings.
Axe silhouette and haft length vary between the main and isolated prop views; choose one canonical head and shaft and preserve the two-hand grip spacing.
Rune staff stone/cradle shape varies in small views. Fix its pivot, weight and grip from one mesh.
The environment rune beacon appears as the existing cyan crystal tower family; a distinct slate rune-stone variant is still a future modeling choice.
Longship hull/deck/keel, bridge joints and ramp grades are illustrated concepts; traversability, occlusion, buoyancy and collision have not been validated.
